column3: Names the muttaqin as recipients of reminder, supporting protective attentiveness; it also pairs this with a protected garden-oriented reading.
The exception-and-remnant scene does not materially clarify the muttaqin or mafazan of 78:31.
Frames taqwa as a sustained orientation, adding a behavioral dimension to the muttaqin in 78:31.
Places al-jannah near the muttaqin, a close parallel to 78:31's promised favorable outcome.
The earth-as-resting-place image supplies no specific link to 78:31.
Provides the contrary horizon: taqwa is set against the prepared Fire, so mafazan can retain escape-from-harm alongside attainment.
Directly joins the muttaqin to gardens of blessing, specifying one outcome compatible with 78:31 without exhausting mafazan.
The warning of coming knowledge gives only broad local-surah context.
Uses mafazah negatively, denying that false self-satisfaction is distance from punishment; it sharpens the escape side of 78:31.
Associates the final outcome with the muttaqin amid patience and reliance, making 78:31's result more than present possession or power.

Calls the lasting garden outcome al-fawz al-azim, preserving both successful attainment and deliverance as parallels for mafazan.
Links the final outcome to the muttaqin after endurance, supporting 78:31's future-oriented promise.

Connects taqwa with a superior later recompense, extending 78:31 from identity to enduring consequence.

Calls the combined rescue and gain al-fawz al-azim; the contrary escape reading remains alongside attainment.

Calls entry into lasting gardens al-fawz al-azim, supporting both arrival and safety readings of mafazan.

The final warning establishes broad contrast but no specific reading beyond the adjacent passage.

Directly assigns the muttaqin a good return, a close outcome-parallel to mafazan.

Names forgiveness and entry into lasting gardens al-fawz al-azim, retaining both protection and attainment in the result.

Brings al-jannah near to the muttaqin, an especially close parallel to 78:31's favorable destination.
Divine authority over speech gives only distant judgment-scene context for 78:31.

Places the muttaqin amid gardens and blessing, a direct outcome-parallel to mafazan.

Names the Book as guidance for the muttaqin, supporting a formative path to 78:31 rather than defining its outcome.

Human pairing gives no specific contribution to the muttaqin's mafazan.
